Bug_Title: Classes extending java.lang.Thread should provide a specific "run" behavior
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the MyThread class, which extends java.lang.Thread but does not override the run method. Therefore, when the thread is started, it does not execute any custom logic defined in doSomething().
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of MyThreadExample. Since MyThread does not override the run method, it does not execute the doSomething method, and thus the assertion fails.
